changes.title: Apple is working on iPhone-to-Windows copy-paste
changes.summary: Apple is working on a feature that will allow users in the European Union to copy content on their iPhone and paste it onto their Windows PC (or vice versa), as spotted earlier by MacRumors . The move comes in response to an interoperability request from Microsoft that asks Apple to open up its Universal Clipboard feat.

changes.title: Apple briefly yanked Telegram from the App Store over CSAM violations
changes.summary: Telegram is back on the App Store after Apple briefly removed it on Monday night over concerns about child sexual abuse material (CSAM). In a statement to Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman , Apple says a review found that Telegram "violates our strict guidelines prohibiting child sexual abuse material," adding that it restored.
